_note: Books on the site. 'file' is the base name in BOOKS_DIR (default ../deliverables/book); the site always serves its highest -vN version, so publishing a new edition needs no change here. Slugs: lowercase letters, digits and dashes only. 'offer' is how a book is offered: free (the PDF for an email), paid (sold here at priceCents, in cents), amazon (sold on Amazon -- set amazonUrl when it is live; until then the page runs a waitlist), none (kept, not shown). 'page' is the site path of the book's own sales page; 'facts' names its section in server/src/generated/facts.json.
